title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Speech at the United Nations
partialText: President Trump’s remarks about oil reserves, the drug trade and his peace efforts contained falsehoods and exaggerations.

title: U.N. Searches for Its Next Leader
partialText: António Guterres is stepping down in December after two terms as secretary general. No front-runner to succeed him has emerged so far.

title: Trump Officials Eject 750,000 From Obamacare Markets, Claiming Fraud
partialText: Vice President JD Vance said the measure would save the government $2.2 billion.

title: Veterans Package Stalls After House’s Swift Departure
partialText: A veterans benefits bill that Republicans had hoped to pass ahead of the midterm elections is falling apart amid a battle over its cost.

title: Will Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez Run for President in 2028? Here’s What She Said.
partialText: In a wide-ranging interview, the New York congresswoman offered her most detailed insight yet into how she is thinking about a possible presidential run.

title: An Army of Paid Creators Is Carpeting the Web With Political Content
partialText: Unlike celebrity influencers with large followings, these creators produce a blizzard of videos for a fraction of the cost of traditional online campaigns and, in the process, shift public conversation.

title: Republicans in Tight Senate Races Call for End to Iran War
partialText: Representative Ashley Hinson of Iowa and Mike Rogers of Michigan distanced themselves from President Trump amid concern that high diesel prices could hurt the party in November.

partialText: Texas and even Florida are the places to watch in November if a polling pattern holds.

title: How Trump Has Cracked Down on Dissent Since the Killing of Charlie Kirk
partialText: The White House has labeled critics terrorists, attributed violence to a left-wing conspiracy and investigated unions, nonprofits and other groups in a battle over free speech.

title: Trump Is Back on TV, Briefly, as Many Networks Carry His U.N. Speech Live
partialText: A suspension of pool coverage remains in effect. But the in-house United Nations broadcaster provided a feed of the president’s remarks.

title: Trump and Xi to Discuss A.I. Risks and Competition at US-China Summit
partialText: Artificial intelligence is on the agenda when leaders from the United States and China meet this week. But with little consensus on a path forward, expectations are limited.

title: China’s Leader Xi Seeks to Extend Truce with Trump During U.S. Summit
partialText: Facing an American president constrained by war and politics, China’s leader may seek to lock in a tactical truce while he shores up a fragile economy at home.

title: How Paramount Won Warner Bros.
partialText: Inside the settlement talks between the media mogul David Ellison and the coalition of states seeking to block his $111 billion deal.

title: How Unions Are Confronting A.I. Threats in the Workplace
partialText: The machinists union shows how workers are negotiating for a say in the ways artificial intelligence is used in their workplaces.

title: Anthropic Releases a New A.I. Model, Opus 5.5, Amid Safety Debate
partialText: The company released a cheaper, faster model that it said was the strongest performer on its most rigorous internal safety tests to date.

title: An A.I. Image of Trump Kissing a Woman Was Fake. It Spread Anyway.
partialText: Advances in artificial intelligence and the myriad ways content is shared online have made establishing authenticity even more difficult for users of social media.

title: Mathematics Isn’t Just a Game to Let A.I. Solve. History Shows Why.
partialText: In our field of applied mathematics, the long, human process of trial and error — not just the solutions themselves — is often what has led to progress.

title: The Other Victims of China’s Church Crackdown
partialText: Cherie Geng is trying to free her husband, a pastor, who was among dozens of church members detained by the Chinese police. At the same time, she must rebuild her life in exile.

title: Tech-Utopian Movement Praxis Says It Has Found a Home in Uruguay
partialText: After a sprawling world tour, Praxis, a New York-based, crypto-backed “digital nation,” has signed a deal to build a physical city in Uruguay.

title: Many Americans Use GLP-1 Drugs Without a Medical Reason, Study Shows
partialText: A new study identified more than 1 million people taking weight-loss drugs without any apparent medical reason to do so.

title: They Had No Connection to Costa Rica. America Sent Them There Anyway.

title: Hayden Panettiere’s Death Caused by Overdose of Fentanyl and Other Drugs
partialText: Ms. Panettiere, who starred in “Heroes” and “Nashville,” died last month at the age of 36. Her death was ruled accidental.
